title: Marguerite and the Autopsy
author: M. M. Hartwell
blurb: Ada Thackeray, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
